request.style: English, female jazz vocal, smooth, upright bass, piano, acoustic guitar, brushed drums, mellow mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the land where the Horites once stood
Before Esau came to claim the land
Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon
Anah and Dishon in the sun
Ezer and Dishan held the place
Chiefs of the clans in the ancient days
Timna was Lotan's sister true
And Shobal had sons who bore his name

[Chorus]
Alvan and Manahath and Ebal
Shepho and Onam in the line
These were the sons of Shobal's house
Living in the land of Seir
Alyan and Manahath again
Ebal and Shephi and Onam
Recorded in the book of days
Part of Edom's early fame

[Verse]
The Horite chiefs held clan by clan
In the land of Seir they dwelt
Before the descendants of Esau
Came to take their inheritance
The genealogy lists them clear
From Genesis to Chronicles' page
Zepho is found in the list of sons
Within the structure of the tribe

[Chorus]
Alvan and Manahath and Ebal
Shepho and Onam in the line
These were the sons of Shobal's house
Living in the land of Seir
Alyan and Manahath again
Ebal and Shephi and Onam
Recorded in the book of days
Part of Edom's early fame

[Outro]
Sons of Shobal in the land
Names preserved for the generations
